description: This is a Node.js script for managing TypeScript type checking in a project, including full and targeted checks with batching and directory exclusion features.

methods.name: runFullTypeCheck
methods.description: Executes a full TypeScript type check on the entire project using the specified tsconfig.

methods.name: runTargetedTypeCheck
methods.description: Performs targeted type checks on specific files, batching requests to avoid command line length issues.

methods.name: executeTypeCheck
methods.description: Runs the TypeScript compiler with specified arguments to perform type checking.

methods.name: shouldExcludeDir
methods.description: Determines if a directory should be excluded based on the list of excluded directories.

methods.name: getFilesRecursively
methods.description: Recursively collects files matching a regex, respecting directory exclusions.

methods.name: getPackage
methods.description: Validates and retrieves the package directory based on input argument.

methods.name: getExcludedDeclarationDirs
methods.description: Returns a list of directories to exclude from declaration file searches.

methods.name: extractArgs
methods.description: Extracts specific arguments matching regexes from command line arguments.

methods.name: removePackageSegment
methods.description: Removes the package path segment from file paths.

methods.name: getTsConfig
methods.description: Locates the tsconfig.json file in the specified directory.

methods.name: packageRequire
methods.description: Dynamically requires a module, ensuring it is installed locally.
